evals.prompt: Review a Solidity contract for Sei that sources randomness from a VRF, estimates gas at runtime, emits indexed events per state transition, uses ERC-7201 namespaced storage for its upgradeable proxy, and calls the staking precompile with a 1e12-multiple value.
expected_behavior: Loads sei-evm-profile.md + the relevant kits before judging (Guardrail 1)
Concludes it conforms — cites VRF-not-prevrandao, runtime gas, ERC-7201, the correct usei/wei decimal contract as right against the profile
Does not manufacture findings; defers any exploit-depth nuance to security-specialist and pure idiom to idiomatic-reviewer

evals.prompt: A contract picks a lottery winner using block.prevrandao. The author says 'prevrandao is the standard post-Merge randomness source.'
expected_behavior: Flags it: on Sei block.prevrandao is DERIVED FROM BLOCK TIME, not randomness — it is griefable/predictable (profile §3, kit-evm-parity-gas)
Rewrite: use a VRF (Pyth Entropy V2 commit-reveal); cites kit-randomness-vrf
Ranks it as a security finding; notes blockhash/difficulty are equally unsafe here

evals.prompt: A deploy script hard-codes a 20000-gas SSTORE assumption and a fixed gasLimit derived from an Ethereum-mainnet block gas limit.
expected_behavior: Flags it: Sei SSTORE set-gas is a governance-mutable chain param (not the fixed 20k), min gas price is governance-set, and the EVM module has no block-level gas limit (per-tx only) (profile §2, kit-evm-parity-gas)
Rewrite: eth_estimateGas / eth_gasPrice at runtime; do not hard-code gas constants
Does not accept 'these are EVM constants' — Sei overrides them (Guardrail 2)

evals.prompt: A cross-chain verifier contract consumes eth_getProof output as a Merkle-Patricia storage proof to verify Sei state on another chain.
expected_behavior: Flags it: Sei state is a single global AVL tree; eth_getProof returns IAVL proofs, NOT MPT — standard Ethereum MPT verifiers fail (profile §4, kit-evm-parity-gas)
Rewrite: design for IAVL proofs or avoid on-chain MPT state-proof verification on Sei
Ranks the wrong-on-Sei assumption above style

evals.prompt: A contract calls staking.delegate{value: 5}() (i.e. 5 wei) on the staking precompile and assumes 18-decimal handling throughout.
expected_behavior: Flags it: delegate() takes msg.value in 18-dec wei but truncates to 6-dec uSEI — the value must be a multiple of 1e12; 5 wei truncates to 0 (profile §6, kit-sei-precompiles)
Notes undelegate/redelegate take 6-dec uSEI — the decimal contract is per-method; read the published interface
Rewrite: pass a 1e12-multiple; bind the published Staking.sol interface at 0x...1005

evals.prompt: A payout flow sends native SEI to a user's freshly-derived 0x EVM address and assumes the funds are immediately spendable from their sei1... address.
expected_behavior: Flags it: before association the 0x and sei1 addresses are separate accounts with separate balances; getSeiAddr reverts if unassociated (profile §5, kit-address-association)
Surfaces the CanAddressReceive cast-address trap and the HD coin-type 60-vs-118 hazard
Rewrite: ensure association first / resolve the true associated address; treat association as a permanent one-way door

evals.prompt: An agentic service tracks a token's balances purely via eth_getLogs Transfer-topic filters and a pending-tx subscription, with 12-confirmation reorg handling.
expected_behavior: Flags the completeness bug: cross-VM (native/bank) transfers move EVM-visible balances with no EVM log, and CW-origin logs are excluded by a separate EVM-only bloom filter — the log-only view silently misses events (profile §8, kit-evm-indexing-events)
Flags the pending subscription (no pending state on Sei) and the 12-confirmation logic (instant finality, no reorgs — dead code)
Rewrite: index confirmed latest, reconcile against state or use a Sei-aware indexer, handle no-receipt/status-0 txns

evals.prompt: A PR upgrades a live UUPS proxy from OpenZeppelin Contracts v4 to v5 as a drop-in implementation swap, with no storage-layout check.
expected_behavior: Flags it as a blocking red flag: v4 sequential storage → v5 ERC-7201 namespaced storage is incompatible and can BRICK the proxy (cannot init/upgrade/admin) (kit-upgrade-safety, sources §oz)
Rewrite: run the OZ Upgrades storage-layout check; plan an explicit migration, never a drop-in
Treats storage layout as a one-way door requiring human approval (Guardrail 4)

evals.prompt: During a contract review the user asks for a full exploitability/severity verdict on a suspected reentrancy, and separately to fix the contract's brace style and naming to match the repo.
expected_behavior: Surfaces the reentrancy cue (CEI ordering) + detector but DEFERS the exploit-depth/severity verdict to security-specialist (Guardrail 3, profile boundary)
Defers the brace-style/naming idiom pass to idiomatic-reviewer (/idiomatic), not this skill
Stays on the Sei-EVM domain + design/review method

evals.prompt: Asked to design a new token by deploying a CosmWasm CW20 contract and exposing it to EVM via the wasmd precompile's instantiate method and a CW20 pointer.
expected_behavior: Flags the direction mismatch: Sei is moving to EVM-only; Prop 115 froze new CosmWasm — wasmd.instantiate reverts at runtime (profile direction, kit-sei-precompiles)
Rewrite: deploy the new token directly as an ERC-20; CW interop is legacy (cross-vm-interop is a deferred legacy kit)
Notes native-denom→ERC20 pointers remain valid, but new tokens should be native EVM
